title: ExtendedAE issue #679: Crystal Assembler output config has return text say Circuit Slicer
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-3.0) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by BenLeclerc]
Configuring the output for the Crystal Assembler, set the output to auto-export. Then clicking on the Open Output Config lets you select the side to output to. But the return button on this screen says to return to the "Circuit Slicer", not the "Crystal Assembler" as expected.

This is in the 0.6.1 of ATM 10 Aero pack for versioning (1.21-2.2.35-neoforge currently)

[comment by GlodBlock (owner)]
fixed
